proposed_candidates.ko: 양쪽 어깨 스트랩이 견갑 사이 중앙 Y형 등판으로 수렴하는 레이서백 구조
proposed_candidates.en: two shoulder straps converging into one central racerback yoke between the shoulder blades
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: rear garment topology where left and right shoulder straps converge into a single central Y-shaped or narrow racerback panel between the shoulder blades, unlike parallel straps or an X crossing

proposed_candidates.ko: 두 어깨 스트랩이 등에서 X자로 교차해 반대편 하부에 연결되는 크로스백
proposed_candidates.en: two shoulder straps crossing once on the back before attaching to opposite lower sides
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: two distinct shoulder straps cross at the back and continue toward opposite lower attachment points, preserving an X path rather than merging into one racerback yoke

proposed_candidates.ko: 컵 아래에서 하부 갈비뼈까지 이어지는 넓은 롱라인 언더밴드
proposed_candidates.en: an extended sports-bra underband continuing below the cups over the lower ribcage
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: sports bra whose cup body continues into a broad fitted underband covering part of the lower ribcage, clearly longer than a standard bra band and distinct from a separate cropped tank

proposed_candidates.ko: 좌우 컵과 중심 브리지가 각각 읽히는 스포츠브라 인캡슐레이션 구조
proposed_candidates.en: two separately shaped sports-bra cups joined by a readable center bridge
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: front sports-bra construction with individually shaped left and right cups and a center bridge, unlike one flat continuous compression panel or printed cup shadows

proposed_candidates.ko: 탱크 안쪽에 별도 라이너와 언더밴드가 연결된 셸프브라 구조
proposed_candidates.en: an internal shelf-bra liner and underband visibly integrated inside a tank top
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: one tank garment with a separately readable inner bust liner and underbust shelf band attached inside, not a sports bra worn underneath an unrelated tank

proposed_candidates.ko: 앞 중심에서 좌우 허리밴드 가장자리가 겹쳐 교차하는 레깅스 허리 구조
proposed_candidates.en: left and right waistband edges overlapping into a real crossover at center front
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: legging waistband with two separately traceable edges that cross and overlap at center front before continuing to opposite sides, unlike a printed V or one decorative diagonal seam

proposed_candidates.ko: 뒤 중심 상단이 V자로 낮아지는 레깅스 허리밴드
proposed_candidates.en: a legging waistband whose top edge dips into a centered V at the back
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: rear waistband topology with a symmetric V-shaped dip in the actual top edge at center back, not merely a chevron print, curved yoke seam or lighting shadow

proposed_candidates.ko: 뒤 중심 세로 채널을 따라 천이 반복적으로 모이는 스크런치 봉제
proposed_candidates.en: a shortened center-back seam channel gathering the legging fabric into repeated ruching
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: garment-owned center-back seam channel visibly shortens and gathers the fabric into repeated small ruches, distinct from body shadow, contour print or a plain flat center seam

proposed_candidates.ko: 앞 중심 세로 봉제가 없는 레깅스 전면 구조
proposed_candidates.en: a continuous legging front with no center-front seam from waistband to crotch
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: front-facing leggings show continuous fabric from waistband through the front rise without a vertical center-front stitch line, treated as an absence attribute rather than proof of full seamless construction

proposed_candidates.ko: 루즈한 외부 쇼츠 셸과 별도 밀착 이너 쇼츠의 두 겹 구조
proposed_candidates.en: a loose outer short shell over separately readable fitted inner shorts
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: two-in-one athletic shorts use a loose outer shell and a separately readable fitted inner short with its own two leg hems under one waist system, unlike a brief liner or color-blocked single layer

proposed_candidates.ko: 외부 러닝 쇼츠 안에 팬티형 라이너가 연결된 구조
proposed_candidates.en: an outer running short with a separately constructed brief-shaped inner liner
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: running shorts with a brief-shaped inner liner attached at the waist and gusset, visible only at the leg opening or controlled stride, unlike longer fitted inner shorts in a two-in-one design

proposed_candidates.ko: 옆선이 실제로 열리고 앞뒤 패널이 겹쳐 움직이는 스플릿 러닝 쇼츠
proposed_candidates.en: a real side opening where overlapping front and back running-short panels separate in stride
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: running-short side construction with an actual open slit and overlapping front and back panels that separate during a natural stride, distinct from contrast piping or a merely curved dolphin hem

proposed_candidates.ko: 한 벌 액티브 드레스의 외부 스커트 아래 연결된 별도 이너 쇼츠

proposed_candidates.embedding_text: one active dress continues from upper body into an outer skirt while a fitted inner short liner with two leg openings is visibly integrated inside, unlike an ordinary dress worn over separate bike shorts

proposed_candidates.ko: 사이클 쇼츠에서 어깨 스트랩과 상부 메시·안장 패드까지 이어지는 빕 구조

proposed_candidates.embedding_text: fitted cycling shorts continue upward into a bib torso section and two shoulder straps, with an anatomically placed saddle pad or explicit cycling context, unlike suspenders clipped to ordinary shorts

proposed_candidates.ko: 각 레깅스 밑단에서 발바닥 아래로 이어지는 스터럽 고리
proposed_candidates.en: a strap extending from each legging hem under the arch of the foot
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: each legging hem splits or extends into a garment-owned strap that passes beneath the foot arch and reconnects, distinct from socks, footwear straps or footed tights

proposed_candidates.ko: 손등까지 연장된 소매 커프의 전용 엄지 구멍
proposed_candidates.en: an extended sleeve cuff with a dedicated thumb opening through the garment
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: long-sleeve activewear cuff extends over the hand back and the thumb passes through a finished opening in the sleeve fabric, not a separate fingerless glove or sleeve draped over the hand

proposed_candidates.ko: 표면에 낮게 눕는 넓은 다중 실 액티브웨어 봉제선

proposed_candidates.embedding_text: native-scale activewear seam with a broad low-profile multi-thread ladder or loop path joining panels without a bulky raised allowance; exact stitch classification remains unclaimed if the thread path is unclear

proposed_candidates.ko: 실 돌출이 거의 없는 낮고 매끈한 접합 가장자리
proposed_candidates.en: a smooth low-profile garment edge or panel join with little visible thread bulk
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: activewear panel edge appears smoothly joined with minimal visible thread and a thin low-profile bond or tape; the photograph does not distinguish adhesive bonding from thermal welding

proposed_candidates.ko: 가랑이 또는 겨드랑이 움직임 지점에 연결된 별도 다각형 거싯 패널

proposed_candidates.embedding_text: a localized panel with real open mesh or repeated perforations is bounded and attached to the same garment, distinct from printed dots, lace ornament or background showing through a tear

proposed_candidates.embedding_text: cycling ensemble with a fitted jersey and bib shorts whose torso straps, upper mesh, leg grippers and saddle-pad region form a coherent riding system rather than generic suspenders and bike shorts

proposed_profiles.composition_instruction: Use an upper-body or three-quarter rear view with both shoulders, shoulder blades, strap paths and lower band visible.
Show the full bra from neckline through the lower ribcage and keep the waistband of any lower garment separated from the bra hem.
Use a neutral front or limited three-quarter upper-body view that shows both cup boundaries, the center bridge, straps and underband without deep shadows.
Use a full-body or waist-to-knee three-quarter stride with both outer-shell and inner-short hems visible on at least one side and the shared waist readable.
Use a side or three-quarter natural running stride that shows the open side path and overlapping front/back panels without turning the opening into a tear.
Use a neutral step or three-quarter court/running stance that exposes part of the inner shorts while preserving the full outer skirt panel and shared waist.
Use a full or three-quarter side step showing the complete dress silhouette and a restrained glimpse of both fitted inner-short legs under the outer skirt.
Show a full-body or torso-to-knee cycling view with the jersey opened or omitted enough to reveal the bib straps, upper section, short legs and saddle-pad region.
Use a front or limited three-quarter full-body stance showing the upper garment, waist, crotch, inseam and both selected-length fitted legs in one uninterrupted unit.
Use a full-body or lower-leg frame with both ankle hems, bare or minimally covered feet and the under-arch strap path visible outside the shoes.
